reproducedCanonicalDefect.reason: Canonical EconomyRepository still appends an operation and then sorts snapshot.operations lexically by operationId. validateSnapshot later replays that sorted list and rejects any transient negative running balance. Therefore a legitimate durable credit recorded before a later debit can be persisted debit-first solely because its operationId sorts later, causing Repository.open/reload to reject the stored snapshot with INVALID_BALANCE_HISTORY.
directStaticEvidence: apply(): table.sort(candidate.operations, function(a, b) return a.operationId < b.operationId end)
validateSnapshot(): expectedBalance accumulates snapshot.operations in stored order and rejects expectedBalance < 0 with INVALID_BALANCE_HISTORY
current economy_repository_spec.lua does not cover a credit whose operationId sorts after a later debit
reproducedCanonicalDefect.exitCriterion: On an exact canonical descendant, deterministic coverage must prove a durable +100 credit under a lexically-later operationId followed by a durable -40 debit under a lexically-earlier operationId reopens successfully at balance 60. Duplicate-ID, conflicting-ID, ownership, CAS retry, exactly-once durability, insufficient-funds behavior, and save/rejoin must remain green.
